newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair cargo traffic up 7.8 pct in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Swissair cargo traffic up 7.8 pct in Aug.

text.p: Swissair said cargo traffic on South America was booming, volume transported in August 1996 rising 30.5 percent on the same month last year.

The airline said: "The level of demand for cargo capacity to Buenos Aires and Sao Paulo is very encouraging. At the end of last month we launched a weekly full-freighter service between Basel and Sao Paulo using a 68-tonne capacity DC10-30F."
Global cargo shipments transported in August 1996 totalled 126.8 million freight tonne kilometres FTK, up 7.8 percent on the 1995 levels.
Having been in decline earlier this year, North Atlantic cargo traffic recorded 9.8 percent growth on August 1996, to 50.9 million FTK, the airline said.
Ex-Switzerland-Far East cargo routes (excluding Japan) traffic was up 11.7 percent to 42.5 million FTK.
Airfreight carried on Switzerland-Japan routes was up 8.6 percent at 10.0 million FTK.
